title: Lint, format, typing and docs tooling in click
answers: What linters and type checkers does click use?
How do I build the docs?
body:
- Style: pre-commit (`.pre-commit-config.yaml`): ruff-check, ruff-format, uv-lock, codespell (`--ignore-words-list=inout,te`), pre-commit-hooks basics. Run `uv run pre-commit run --all-files` or `tox r -e style`; CI via `.github/workflows/pre-commit.yaml`.
- Ruff (`pyproject.toml` `[tool.ruff]`): excludes `examples/`, `fix = true`, rules B,E,F,I,UP,W,ICN; isort `force-single-line`; `typing` must be imported as `t`.
- Typing: `tox r -e typing` runs `mypy` (strict, over `src` and `tests/typing`, `[tool.mypy]`) and `pyright --ignoreexternal --verifytypes click` (`[tool.pyright]` basic). `uv run mypy` works directly.
- Docs: Sphinx + MyST in `docs/` (`docs/conf.py`, `docs` dependency group). `tox r -e docs` = `sphinx-build -E -W -b dirhtml docs docs/_build/dirhtml` (-W: warnings are errors). `tox r -e docs-auto` uses sphinx-autobuild, also watching `src`. Read the Docs (`.readthedocs.yaml`) uses `uv run --group docs sphinx-build -W -b dirhtml ...`.
- Maintenance envs: `update-actions`, `update-pre_commit`, `update-requirements`. Changelog: `CHANGES.md`.
